assay_targets_or_enrichments.ontology_label: Affinity purification coupled with mass spectrometry proteomics

acquisition: The mass spectrometer was operated in a data-dependent top 10 or top 15 mode.
analyzed in single runs by LC-MS/MS on a Q Exactive plus or Q Exactive HF (Thermo Fisher Scientific) using a top10 or top15 method.
labeling: Label-free quantitative mass spectrometry-based proteomics was used to detect and relatively quantify interaction partners of PWWP2A.
quantification: Label-free quantification was performed using the MaxLFQ algorithm integrated into MaxQuant.
quantified using the MaxLFQ algorithm for label-free quantification.
enrichment: GFP- or GFP–PWWP2A bound nucleosomal proteins were subjected to on-bead tryptic digestion and then quantitated by label-free MS/MS.

workflow_hints: Affinity purification coupled with mass spectrometry proteomics

Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The study contains two distinct MS approaches: 1) PRM for histone modification quantification and 2) DDA-LFQ for AP-MS of PWWP2A interactors. The PRIDE metadata and the 'Label-free quantitative MS' section specifically describe the DDA-LFQ workflow for the interactome, which is the primary focus of the proteomics dataset (PXD010202). The PRM data is described as a separate 'MS identification of histone modifications' analysis.

scope: chromatin isolated from HK cells stably expressing GFP or GFP–PWWP2A were digested with MNase to mononucleosomes... and immunoprecipitated with GFP-TRAP beads
GFP- or GFP–PWWP2A bound nucleosomal proteins were subjected to on-bead tryptic digestion and then quantitated by label-free MS/MS
Single-step IPs of mononucleosomes carrying GFP-tagged PWWP2A were essentially performed as described before
Affinity purification of tagged PWWP2A from HK cells revealed a number of significantly enriched proteins

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The proteomics analysis focused on the interactome of PWWP2A using GFP-TRAP affinity purification from mononucleosomes derived from HeLa Kyoto (HK) cells. While HEK293 cells were used for some biochemical assays, the primary label-free quantitative MS data described in the PRIDE metadata and results section refers to the PWWP2A pulldowns from HK cells.
